segments.name: diabetes management
products: continuous glucose monitoring systems and sensors
segments.description: Develops, manufactures and markets insulin pumps, glucose sensors, consumables and dosing software used by people with diabetes and their clinicians.
segments.evidence: The Company manages its business activities on a consolidated basis and operates as one operating and reportable segment.

revenueModel.text: People with diabetes and their clinicians buy insulin pumps, sensors, consumables and software, largely through distributors in the durable medical equipment channel.
revenueModel.evidence: We currently utilize a dual-channel approach in the United States where we distribute the majority of our products through the DME channel and only a small percentage of our products through the pharmacy channel
